experiment_data.hypothesis: T=0.5 will increase degeneracy rate (more deterministic outputs) and compress LP range on SciERC, reducing selection headroom. Maps the low-temperature end of the degeneracy-temperature frontier, validating that degeneracy is regime-dependent on sampling temperature.
